Coram : V.N. KHARE, S.B. SINHA
OF KERALA AND· ORS. V. N. AVINASIAPPAN NOVEMBER 20, 2003 B (V.N. KHARE, CJ. AND S.B. SINHA, J.] Excise Law : Kera/a Abkari Act, 1977 : C S. 67F-Revision-Suo motu powers of Commissioner-Opportunity of hearing-Application before Excise Commissioner for suo motu exercise of revisional power D reasons for rejecting the application-Held, merely because a party to the proceedings may bring an order passed u/s. 67B or s. 67E to the notice of the Commissioner, the same would not ipso facto mean that he has to exercise his suo motu powers-A parry to the appeal in terms of s. 67B or 67E
Decision Date : 20-11-2003 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 225/1999 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
